_doc: Reader on the pessimistic Plus profile (foundation §4.5/§4.7). Page-turn targets are design goals for this panel (GL16 37 phases x 16 ms = 592 ms of pure waveform).

reader.page_turns.why: keys, swipes and tap zones must all turn pages

reader.turns_prerendered.why: most forward turns should hit the page rendered ahead of time

ui.action_to_visible_ms.TEXT.p95.why: page turn fully visible within 1 s on this panel

reader.page_render_ms.p95.why: layout + glyph rendering of one page

display.underruns.why: no flash write may overlap a waveform

storage.write_ms.count.why: the reading position must be saved

mem.internal.min_free_bytes.why: pessimistic profile: ~5 KiB headroom (see docs: DMA reserve and display driver budgets)
